description_en: Calls this operation to list the supported services
kebab_example: aliyun cloudcontrol list-products --x-acs-accept-language zh_CH --provider Aliyun --next-token ECS --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListProducts

parameters.help_en:
Select the language in which the response is returned.

zh_CH: Chinese (default).

en_US: English
parameters.help_zh:
选择返回产品的语言。

zh_CH：中文 （默认）

en_US：英文
parameters.name: x_acs_accept_language

parameters.help_en: The Cloud service provider. Only Aliyun is supported
parameters.name: provider

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100
parameters.name: max_results
